implementation.mathematics: Reduction modulo m from Z_n to Z_m preserves addition when m divides n. Every source and target product, every map value, all identities and inverses, and the restricted kernel operation are recorded as typed facts. The entire finite homomorphism law and subgroup axioms are checked, rather than inferred from selected arrows.
